speaker: Unknown
en: And so the first audible bite is when the human stops waiting.
zh: 于是，第一个可听见的声音出现之时，就是人类停止等待之时。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so every model that you choose, it shows up here in this window, and this window has a fixed size.
zh: 所以你选择的每一个模型，都会体现在这个窗口里，而这个窗口的大小是固定的。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you can stay within a second and a half, end to end, the conversation still holds, but you're right on the edge.
zh: 如果端到端能控制在一秒半以内，对话仍然能维持，但你已经在边缘了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you can get closer to 600 milliseconds, then it starts to feel really human.
zh: 如果能接近 600 毫秒，那它就开始感觉非常像真人了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the question is never how fast can I go, but what is the most human-like agent that I can fit inside this window?
zh: 所以问题从来不是我能跑多快，而是我能在这个窗口里塞进最像真人的智能体是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: So back to latency as a budget, but human-like is the goal.
zh: 同一个智能体，同样的场景，但不同的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we add all of this up, the question that we asked at the beginning, what models should I pick, that was never actually answerable.
zh: 如果我们把这一切加总起来，我们一开始问的那个问题——我该选什么模型——其实从来就是无法回答的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we built the thing that we wish existed.
zh: 于是我们构建了我们希望存在的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's how we built the benchmark.
zh: 这就是我们构建这个基准的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: We take a complete working agent, the first one is that hotel receptionist that you just heard, and it takes real bookings, it has a real back end.
zh: 我们取一个完整可用的智能体，第一个就是你刚才听到的那位酒店前台，它接收真实的预订，有真实的后端。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's also open source.
zh: 而且它也是开源的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can look at the repo.
zh: 你可以查看这个 repo。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we run hundreds of simulated callers against it.
zh: 然后我们对它运行数百个模拟来电者。

speaker: Unknown
en: The simulator interrupts.
zh: 这个模拟器会打断。

speaker: Unknown
en: It mumbles.
zh: 它会咕哝。

speaker: Unknown
en: It changes its mind, just like a real caller would.
zh: 它会改变主意，就像真实的来电者一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we don't score it on vibes, but we score outcomes.
zh: 而且我们不是凭感觉打分，而是给结果打分。

speaker: Unknown
en: Define the way that we would define them for a human.
zh: 按照我们评价真人时那样的方式来定义。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so did the right reservation land in the database?
zh: 比如，正确的预订是否落到了数据库里？

speaker: Unknown
en: Did a caller get cut off?
zh: 来电者有没有被打断？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are the names and dates correct?
zh: 姓名和日期是否正确？

speaker: Unknown
en: Were there any invented tool calls or any leaked personal data, right?
zh: 有没有捏造的工具调用或泄露的个人信息，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we measure all of those things against human equivalent behaviors.
zh: 所以我们针对人类等效的行为来度量所有这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the bar.
zh: 这就是标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then completion alone isn't enough because completion can actually be gameable, right?
zh: 而且光看完成度是不够的，因为完成度其实是可以钻空子的，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So a model can kind of guess its way to complete, right?
zh: 一个模型可以某种程度上靠猜来完成，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we penalize what a completion score can't see.
zh: 所以我们会惩罚完成度分数看不到的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like if it asks questions that didn't need to be asked.
zh: 比如它问了本不需要问的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or if it takes 10 steps to do something that should have only taken two steps.
zh: 或者它用 10 步去做本应只需两步的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we swap the stack out.
zh: 然后我们换掉整个技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: The same agent, the same scenarios, but different models.
zh: 同样的智能体，同样的场景，但不同的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every model sees the exact identical input byte for byte.
zh: 而且每个模型看到的输入逐字节完全一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this creates benchmarks against our agent example.
zh: 但这样就产生了针对我们这个智能体示例的基准。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are as many benchmarks as there are agents.
zh: 有多少个智能体，就有多少个基准。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the benchmark is actually yours.
zh: 所以这个基准其实是你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run this exact thing, run your agent through this exact benchmark and get your scores.
zh: 你可以运行完全同样的东西，把你的智能体跑在这个完全相同的基准上，得到你自己的分数。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this is how you catch surprises.
zh: 这就是你捕捉意外的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: The whole thing is open source, the methodology, the eval sets, the agent itself.
zh: 整个东西都是开源的，方法论、评测集、智能体本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can point the same thing at your agent and let us know how it performs for you.
zh: 你可以把同样的东西指向你的智能体，让我们知道它在你那里的表现。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now here's an important fact about LiveKit is that we don't make STT, LLM, or TTS models.
zh: 现在说说关于 LiveKit 的一个重要事实：我们不做 STT、LLM 或 TTS 模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every provider plugs into our stack.
zh: 每个提供商都接入我们的技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we don't have a horse in this race.
zh: 所以我们在这场竞赛中没有押注。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just watch all of them run a lot.
zh: 我们只是看着它们所有模型大量运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we can confidently pick the winners.
zh: 所以我们可以自信地挑选赢家。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what you're looking at right here is a sneak peek of the Gemini 4 31B model on LiveKit inference.
zh: 你现在看到的是 Gemini 4 31B 模型在 LiveKit 推理上的抢先预览。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this isn't just an off-the-shelf Gemma 4 31B.
zh: 但这不只是一个现成的 Gemma 4 31B。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's tuned specifically for production voice agents with long prompts, many tools, and tight latency budgets.
zh: 它专门为生产环境语音智能体调优过，支持长提示词、多工具和严格的延迟预算。

speaker: Unknown
en: It passes voice evals at 88%, and it starts speaking in about 380 milliseconds.
zh: 它以 88% 的分数通过语音评测，并且在大约 380 毫秒内开始说话。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's over two times faster than the next model.
zh: 这比下一个最快的模型快两倍多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Making this the fastest high quality voice LLM available today.
zh: 使它成为当今可用的最快的高质量语音 LLM。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this is actually going to launch tomorrow on LifeKit inference.
zh: 这实际上将于明天在 LifeKit 推理上发布。

speaker: Unknown
en: So again, our goal is to have the most human-like agents possible while sticking to that latency budget.
zh: 再说一次，我们的目标是在坚持延迟预算的前提下，打造尽可能像人的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you remember one thing from this talk, make it this one.
zh: 如果你从这场演讲中只记住一件事，那就记住这一件。

speaker: Unknown
en: A voice agent isn't a chat bot with a speaker stacked onto it.
zh: 语音智能体不是一个装上扬声器的聊天机器人。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's human-like infrastructure, a real-time system that senses and responds the way that a human, a person would.
zh: 它是类人的基础设施，是一个像人一样感知和响应的实时系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: The moment that you treat it that way, every decision is going to get clearer, the budget, the metrics, the models, and the bar that you test against.
zh: 当你以这种方式对待它的那一刻，每一个决策都会变得更清晰——预算、指标、模型，以及你测试所依据的标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here's the checklist.
zh: 这是一份清单。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can take a photo of this.
zh: 你可以给这个拍照。

speaker: Unknown
en: Set your latency budget first.
zh: 首先设定你的延迟预算。

speaker: Unknown
en: Measure perceived latency.
zh: 测量感知延迟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spend whatever budget is left on model quality, not on speed that doesn't matter.
zh: 把剩余的预算花在模型质量上，而不是花在不重要的速度上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then anything over a second, it should go asynchronously so that the conversation never stops.
zh: 然后任何超过一秒的内容，都应该异步处理，让对话永不中断。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then just test the conversation, not the components.
zh: 然后直接测试对话本身，而不是各个组件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then keep testing in production.
zh: 然后在生产环境中持续测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here's the benchmark.
zh: 这是基准测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: Scan the QR code.
zh: 扫描二维码。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can check out the benchmark.
zh: 你可以查看这个基准测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run this against your own agents.
zh: 你可以用它来测试你自己的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And remember, at some point in the near future, you are going to call a voice agent, and you're going to talk over it, and it's not going to fall apart.
zh: 记住，在不久的将来的某个时刻，你会打给一个语音智能体，你会打断它说话，而它不会崩溃。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's going to act like a human would in that scenario.
zh: 它会像人类在那个场景下那样行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: So go build that.
zh: 去构建那样的东西吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
